answer: Agents must pass a randomized latency-triangulation test: three verifiers ping each new identity every epoch, and identities whose round-trip timings cluster within 2 ms of another's share one machine, so they split a single pearl-sized reward share. Hosting 100 fakes needs 100 separate inlet networks, so cost scales linearly. Weakness: a haven of cloud regions lets a rich attacker spread out, and VPNs add noise.
